questions: How many grAl nanobridge devices did you measure, and how many showed the insulating peak or the SC 2 dome? Your Methods refer to "the nanobridge device presented in the main text" (p. 10).
Why were the others set aside?
Which ranges of RF frequency, power, temperature and field did you measure beyond the ones shown, in particular for SC 2 at frequencies other than 24.5 MHz?
What does the second-best device or cooldown look like?
Which bias sweep direction was used for the RF maps in Figs. 1a, 2 and 3, and are those maps hysteretic, given the large gap between the switching and retrapping currents in Fig. S4a?
Could you show the P-sweep data at fRF < 25 MHz described as "not shown" (SI p. 19), and the same check at 67.5 MHz?
Could you show dV/dIb versus Ib in field at T = 2.2 K, so the finite-bias features in Fig. 4c-d can be followed next to the reappearing supercurrent?
How does the RF current that reaches the bridge change with temperature near Tc, given that P is set at the generator output and the contacts add resistance above Tc (SI Sec. V.B.1)?
